description: This file is a header (.h) file defining trigger configuration functions and constants for Chrysler vehicles. It declares functions used to configure various trigger shapes for different Chrysler models and initializes certain trigger settings.

methods.name: configureNeon1995TriggerShape
methods.description: Configures the trigger shape for Neon 1995 model.

methods.name: configureNeon1995TriggerShapeOnlyCrank
methods.description: Configures only the crank trigger shape for Neon 1995.

methods.name: configureNeon2003TriggerShapeCam
methods.description: Configures the cam trigger shape for Neon 2003.

methods.name: configureNeon2003TriggerShapeCrank
methods.description: Configures the crank trigger shape for Neon 2003.

methods.name: initDodgeRam
methods.description: Initializes trigger shape for Dodge Ram.

methods.name: configureDodgeStratusTriggerShape
methods.description: Configures trigger shape for Dodge Stratus.

methods.name: initJeep_XJ_4cyl_2500
methods.description: Initializes trigger shape for Jeep XJ 4-cylinder 2500.
